visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair is kneeling in a brightly lit room. He wears a black shirt and brown trousers. Before him, a long, olive-green sleeping bag lies flat on a light wood grain floor. To his left is a white cabinet; behind him, a white pedestal fan and an air purifier. (2) The man gestures with his right hand, pointing upward while speaking. He starts to roll the head section of the sleeping bag. His facial expression is focused and communicative. In the background, books and various small containers are visible on shelves. (3) He rolls the sleeping bag into a thick bundle. He picks up a small green storage sack and begins pushing the bundle inside with significant hand force. The camera stays at a medium-full shot, capturing his kneeling posture and rhythmic arm movements. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the opening of the green storage sack. The man's hands point to a small triangular grey patch sewn onto the fabric. He pulls at the drawstrings to demonstrate the reinforcement. The lighting highlights the texture of the ripstop nylon fabric. (5) He demonstrates two specific hand techniques: a flat palm 'knife-hand' and a clenched fist. He continues stuffing the olive material into the sack using his fist to push it down. His watch is clearly visible on his left wrist. (6) To remove trapped air, he pulls the bundle toward his chest and wraps his arms around it, squeezing tightly. He leans his body weight forward. The sleeping bag's volume visibly decreases as the air is expelled. (7) He continues the stuffing process, rotating the bag between pushes to ensure even distribution. He uses his fingers to tuck the final loose bits of fabric into the top of the sack. Finally, he pulls the drawstring and locks it. (8) The packed sleeping bag sits on the floor next to a beige cardboard cat house. A brown and white cat looks out from the opening. The MCED brand logo is centered in the frame on the green bag.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 高達鬆軟度睡袋怎麼收. [Subtitle]: 高達鬆軟度的羽絨睡袋. (2) [Subtitle]: 這樣收最有效率. 那現在示範的睡袋是380克. 蓬鬆度850FP. (3) [Subtitle]: 保暖可以到10度極暖~5度舒適. (4) [Subtitle]: 然後這個是台灣製的MCED. 也是我們團購很熱賣的睡袋. (5) [Subtitle]: 所以我通常這樣做. 捲一半到1/3. 然後捲了一坨之後先塞一部分. (6) [Subtitle]: 然后再直接收. 三個步驟. 捲. 再來是塞. 最後要排氣. 我收一次哦. (7) [Subtitle]: 我現在我會這樣子折. 然後捲這樣子. (8) [Subtitle]: 你這時候很好捲. 看大概捲成這樣子. (9) [Subtitle]: 就把這一坨給這樣塞進去. (10) [Subtitle]: 這時候就已經先塞了一大坨了. (11) [Subtitle]: 那這個時候塞的時候呢. 力氣不要用太多. (12) [Subtitle]: 因為有些人硬扯住. 他這邊會開掉. (13) [Subtitle]: MCED這個收納袋. 補個三角片. 讓子這個收納袋開口部分它比較不會被你這樣硬扯開. (14) [Subtitle]: 但是我抓著抓著邊邊. 然後去塞. (15) [Subtitle]: 這種手刀型之最有效率. (16) [Subtitle]: 那我太太反應過她這樣子. 她指甲女生指甲很長. 這樣戳的時候呢. 手指會痛. (17) [Subtitle]: 那種方法就是小叮噹手. 是用拳頭這樣抓著握緊. 然後用拳頭塞. (18) [Subtitle]: 然後最後你會發現哦. 你看最後這一坨要排氣. (19) [Subtitle]: 你看就一大坨. 很多空氣. (20) [Subtitle]: 我先這樣子收納. 就這樣子抱著. 輕抱著把空氣排出來. (21) [Subtitle]: 他其實排完後就很小. 他其實都是空氣. 擠壓到最後再塞. (22) [Subtitle]: 我會一邊塞一邊轉. 對我會轉. 你看這樣我會在轉. (23) [Subtitle]: 因為有時候你要塞. 不要都塞同一邊嘛. (24) [Subtitle]: 好. 就塞完了. (25) [Subtitle]: 可可說最後團購優惠喔. 喵~. (26) [Logo]: MCED Mountain & Camp Equipments Design Company.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice provides a steady narration with a friendly and professional tone. The speech rate is moderate. Faint, high-frequency rustling sounds of nylon fabric are heard as he touches the sleeping bag. The background room tone is clean with minimal studio silence. (2) A series of soft, percussive thudding sounds occur as the man kneels and shifts weight on the floor. The voice continues with rising intonation to emphasize key points. Fabric rustling becomes more continuous and intense in volume. (3) Rhythmic, mid-range friction sounds increase as the sleeping bag is stuffed into the sack. There are no musical background tracks. The speaker's volume is consistent, showing moderate conversational intensity. (4) Close-range vocal delivery with clear articulation. A distinct 'crinkling' sound is audible as he demonstrates the reinforced triangular patch on the storage bag. The acoustic brightness is slightly higher due to proximity. (5) Repetitive, low-frequency 'thumping' sounds as the man's fist pushes the down material into the sack. The voice delivery speed remains stable. (6) A prolonged, low-arousal 'whooshing' or hissing sound of air escaping the down feathers. The narrator's voice has a slight breathy quality as he exerts physical effort while hugging the bag. (7) Intense, high-density rustling sounds continue as the final stuffing occurs. The sound of the plastic drawstring toggle clicking against the fabric is heard at the end. (8) A final sentence from the narrator followed by a high-pitched, short-duration 'Meow' vocalization. The audio ends with a clean fade-out of the room tone.
